latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release - Automates creation of Docker-ready Ubuntu 24.04 LXC containers or VMs on Proxmox VE.

- Supports both LXC containers (default) and full VMs.
- Auto-selects next available CTID/VMID to avoid conflicts.
- Sets up Docker & Docker Compose v2 post-boot for immediate use.
- Handles LXC nesting features for Docker-in-LXC scenarios.
- Returns connection info and build summary after creation.
- Includes teardown instructions and critical limitations in references.
